comment.nl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diversen
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>De amendementen 1-5 zijn om technische redenen geannuleerd.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Varie
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Gli emendamenti 1-5 sono stati annullati per motivi tecnici.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Miscellaneous
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendments 1-5 had been cancelled for technical reasons.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Įvairūs
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>1–5 pakeitimai buvo anuliuoti dėl techninių priežasčių.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diversos
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>As alterações 1-5 foram anuladas por razões técnicas.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Aon ghnó eile
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Rinneadh leasuithe 1-5 a chealú ar chúiseanna teicniúla.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Varios
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Las enmiendas 1-5 han sido anuladas por razones técnicas.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Razno
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlogi sprememb 1 do 5 so bili razveljavljeni zaradi tehničnih razlogov.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Divers
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Les amendements 1-5 ont été annulés pour des raisons techniques.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sk:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Iné
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>PN 1 až 5 boli z technických dôvodov zrušené.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diverse
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentele 1-5 au fost anulate din motive tehnice.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Dažādi
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījumi Nr. 1-5 bija atcelti tehnisku iemeslu dēļ.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.de:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Verschiedenes
</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Die Änderungsanträge 1-5 wurden aus technischen Gründen annulliert.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
